rows.subtype: Happy for the friend chosen instead of self [Actor]
rows.description: A teenager not picked for the team is truly glad for the best friend who was, and grieves a little too; mixed feelings are allowed and both are real.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Delight in a partner's or friend's joy [Actor]
rows.description: A young adult beams at a partner's success, even when it takes time away from them; joy in another's happiness is a sign of secure love, not lack of self.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
related mind states: joy, affection, trust

rows.subtype: Person whose success is celebrated feels safe [Receiver]
rows.description: A colleague who shares good news and gets sincere gladness feels safe to be ambitious and open, and is likelier to return the same generosity later.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtype: Restless boredom on a long afternoon [Actor]
rows.description: A child sighs "I am bored" through a holiday afternoon, then after a while invents a game; boredom is often the doorway to imagination when nobody hurries to fill it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Restless emptiness with nothing to want [Actor]
rows.description: A teenager with friends and games feels flat, everything seems pointless, and nothing tempts; the mind wants meaning, not just entertainment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Life feels flat after a big goal is reached [Actor]
rows.description: A young adult who got into their dream college finds themselves oddly hollow; a long-chased goal removed the direction it gave, leaving a quiet weariness.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A young professional moves through the same commute and tasks, not sad but grey and tired of the sameness, and drifts toward numbing habits instead of change.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
related mind states: sadness, tiredness, detachment

rows.subtype: Answering ennui with meaning and, if heavy, with help [Response]
rows.description: An adult tries a new skill, a service role or a change of pattern to make life richer; if the flatness becomes heavy and lasting, they talk to a doctor or counsellor rather than waiting it out.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child holds a small keepsake from home and watches the school gate at midday, aching for a parent; longing shows in going quiet, not always in tears.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager away at a residential school lies awake missing home food, sounds and the family's routines, and hides it from roommates for fear of seeming childish.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 18–22, 23–26
